poll.question: A limping figure reaches the rooftop—alive, impossible to ignore. Hui Ling wants to help. Dan wants to stay sealed. What do they do?

options.label: Open the ramp
options.desc: Trust Hui Ling's heart, pull them up, gamble that hope beats caution

options.label: Stay sealed tight
options.desc: Honor Dan's survival instinct, protect the van, hold their line as two

options.label: Signal first
options.desc: Talk before opening—stay protected but stay human, gather intel before committing
